agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has a very thin wall (w≈0.258, x≈11.62) and a high post-collision velocity. After the body-body collision between steps 1-2, body 0 acquires vx≈-75.4, vy≈53.8 (speed≈92.6 at step2, still ≈92.4 at step4). At step4 its centre is to the right of the wall (x≈12.93, distance to wall surface ≈0.54) and at step5 it is to the left/inside the wall (x≈11.46, distance ≈-0.33, penetration 0.33 >0.15). With dt≈0.0195 split into ~61 substeps, per-substep displacement ≈0.03 < wall thickness, yet discrete CCD/impulse fails to stop the centre crossing the 0.258-thick box between consecutive steps, so the no_tunneling check fires and is accompanied by no_wall_penetration. Thickening the wall to w=2.0 (same position/steps) makes the wall span wide enough that the same trajectory cannot cross in one step, and the collision is resolved, so no violation.
